metadata.name: drawershell-focus-trap
metadata.description: Opens the DrawerShell@1.0.0 preview harness (example=full-open) at top level and proves the focus trap: after focusing the in-panel close button and pressing Tab, keyboard focus stays inside the role=dialog panel instead of leaking to the backdrop or document body. This is the exact failure class the DrawerShell pilot exposed that screenshot-diffs cannot catch. The paired calibration bas/calibration/drawershell-focus-trap-broken.json runs the same assertion against DrawerShell@0.1.0 (which has no useFocusTrap) and must fail.

evaluate.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[role=dialog] button'); if (b) b.focus(); return document.activeElement ? document.activeElement.tagName : 'NONE'; })()

metadata.label: Move focus to the in-panel close button
Press Tab twice to attempt to leave the panel

evaluate.expression: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'); const inside = !!(p && p.contains(document.activeElement)); document.body.setAttribute('data-focus-trapped', inside ? 'yes' : 'no'); return inside; })()

metadata.label: Record whether focus stayed inside the dialog panel

assert.failure_message: Focus escaped the DrawerShell panel after Tab — the focus trap (useFocusTrap) is not holding keyboard focus inside role=dialog. This is the lost-focus-trap regression screenshots cannot catch.

metadata.label: Focus remained trapped inside the drawer
